benefits.text: Let your inner radiance shine with hince's Water Liquid Glow line. The formula contains plenty of moisturizing ingredients without feeling sticky, with a range of colors from light to deep across 9 different shades. With each additional layer, the shine on the lips becomes more visible while the color stays the same.

howToUse.text: Apply directly to lips, and you can layer multiple coats to reach the intensity you want.

safety.text:
For external use on the lip area only; do not use on damaged lips,
Stop use if any unusual signs appear and keep out of reach of children.

texture.text: Liquid glossy tint, thin, lightweight and moist.

sellingPoints.text: Lightweight glossy tint texture; contains plenty of moisturizing ingredients without stickiness; layering makes the shine more visible while keeping the color.

finish.text: Watery gloss / pink beige / soft and natural.

claimDisclaimers.text: “Long-wearing” should not be interpreted as absolutely wear-proof. Do not say it treats dry lips or repairs lips.
